Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly concluded that *My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy* was released under GOOD Music/Def Jam and not Roc-A-Fella Records. This is factually incorrect; the album was released under Roc-A-Fella Records, Def Jam Recordings, and G.O.O.D. Music. Because of this false premise regarding the label, the Planner erroneously rejected the correct answer (*My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy*) and incorrectly switched to *Graduation* (which is on Def Jam/Roc-A-Fella but does not feature Dwele on "Flashing Lights"—Dwele is not on that track). This error led to the final wrong solution.
